## Task: fix pytest #7521 — `capfd.readouterr()` converts `\r` to `\n`

**Cause:** In `FDCaptureBinary.__init__` (src/_pytest/capture.py), the capture temp file is wrapped as `EncodedFile(TemporaryFile(buffering=0), encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", write_through=True)`. `EncodedFile` is an `io.TextIOWrapper`, and without a `newline` argument it runs in universal-newlines mode, which translates `\r` (and `\r\n`) to `\n` **on write** — so anything a test prints to the captured fd loses its carriage returns before `readouterr()` ever sees them. (`CaptureIO`, the sys-level capture, already passes `newline=""` — only the fd path was missing it.)

```diff
--- a/src/_pytest/capture.py
+++ b/src/_pytest/capture.py
@@ -388,6 +388,7 @@ class FDCaptureBinary:
                 TemporaryFile(buffering=0),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                 encoding="utf-8",
                 errors="replace",
+                newline="",
                 write_through=True,
```
